title: BulkRetrieveBookingsResponse
description: Response payload for bulk retrieval of bookings.

bookings.description: Requested bookings returned as a map containing `booking_id` as the key and `RetrieveBookingResponse` as the value.

errors.description: Errors that occurred during the request.

Address.description:
Represents a postal address in a country. 
For more information, see [Working with Addresses](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/working-with-addresses).

address_line_1.description:
The first line of the address.

Fields that start with `address_line` provide the address's most specific
details, like street number, street name, and building name. They do *not*
provide less specific details like city, state/province, or country (these
details are provided in other fields).

address_line_2.description: The second line of the address, if any.

address_line_3.description: The third line of the address, if any.

locality.description: The city or town of the address. For a full list of field meanings by country, see [Working with Addresses](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/working-with-addresses).

sublocality.description: A civil region within the address's `locality`, if any.

sublocality_2.description: A civil region within the address's `sublocality`, if any.

sublocality_3.description: A civil region within the address's `sublocality_2`, if any.

administrative_district_level_1.description:
A civil entity within the address's country. In the US, this
is the state. For a full list of field meanings by country, see [Working with Addresses](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/working-with-addresses).

administrative_district_level_2.description:
A civil entity within the address's `administrative_district_level_1`.
In the US, this is the county.

administrative_district_level_3.description:
A civil entity within the address's `administrative_district_level_2`,
if any.

postal_code.description: The address's postal code. For a full list of field meanings by country, see [Working with Addresses](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/working-with-addresses).

country.description:
The address's country, in the two-letter format of ISO 3166. For example, `US` or `FR`.
See [Country](#type-country) for possible values

first_name.description: Optional first name when it's representing recipient.

last_name.description: Optional last name when it's representing recipient.

AppointmentSegment.description: Defines an appointment segment of a booking.

duration_minutes.description: The time span in minutes of an appointment segment.

service_variation_id.description: The ID of the [CatalogItemVariation](entity:CatalogItemVariation) object representing the service booked in this segment.

team_member_id.description: The ID of the [TeamMember](entity:TeamMember) object representing the team member booked in this segment.

service_variation_version.description: The current version of the item variation representing the service booked in this segment.

intermission_minutes.description: Time between the end of this segment and the beginning of the subsequent segment.

any_team_member.description: Whether the customer accepts any team member, instead of a specific one, to serve this segment.

resource_ids.description: The IDs of the seller-accessible resources used for this appointment segment.

Booking.description:
Represents a booking as a time-bound service contract for a seller's staff member to provide a specified service
at a given location to a requesting customer in one or more appointment segments.

id.description: A unique ID of this object representing a booking.

version.description: The revision number for the booking used for optimistic concurrency.

status.description:
The status of the booking, describing where the booking stands with respect to the booking state machine.
See [BookingStatus](#type-bookingstatus) for possible values

created_at.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp specifying the creation time of this booking.

updated_at.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp specifying the most recent update time of this booking.

start_at.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp specifying the starting time of this booking.

location_id.description: The ID of the [Location](entity:Location) object representing the location where the booked service is provided. Once set when the booking is created, its value cannot be changed.

customer_id.description: The ID of the [Customer](entity:Customer) object representing the customer receiving the booked service.

customer_note.description: The free-text field for the customer to supply notes about the booking. For example, the note can be preferences that cannot be expressed by supported attributes of a relevant [CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) instance.

seller_note.description:
The free-text field for the seller to supply notes about the booking. For example, the note can be preferences that cannot be expressed by supported attributes of a specific [CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) instance.
This field should not be visible to customers.

appointment_segments.description: A list of appointment segments for this booking.

transition_time_minutes.description:
Additional time at the end of a booking.
Applications should not make this field visible to customers of a seller.

all_day.description: Whether the booking is of a full business day.

location_type.description:
The type of location where the booking is held.
See [BusinessAppointmentSettingsBookingLocationType](#type-businessappointmentsettingsbookinglocationtype) for possible values

source.description:
The source of the booking.
Access to this field requires seller-level permissions.
See [BookingBookingSource](#type-bookingbookingsource) for possible values

address.description: Stores a customer address if the location type is `CUSTOMER_LOCATION`.

Indicates the country associated with another entity, such as a business.
Values are in [ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 format](http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/country_codes.htm).

Error.description:
Represents an error encountered during a request to the Connect API.

See [Handling errors](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/handling-errors) for more information.

category.description:
The high-level category for the error.
See [ErrorCategory](#type-errorcategory) for possible values

code.description:
The specific code of the error.
See [ErrorCode](#type-errorcode) for possible values

detail.description: A human-readable description of the error for debugging purposes.

field.description:
The name of the field provided in the original request (if any) that
the error pertains to.

x-enum-elements.name: API_ERROR
x-enum-elements.description: An error occurred with the Connect API itself.

x-enum-elements.name: AUTHENTICATION_ERROR
x-enum-elements.description:
An authentication error occurred. Most commonly, the request had
a missing, malformed, or otherwise invalid `Authorization` header.

x-enum-elements.name: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR
x-enum-elements.description:
The request was invalid. Most commonly, a required parameter was
missing, or a provided parameter had an invalid value.

x-enum-elements.name: RATE_LIMIT_ERROR
x-enum-elements.description:
Your application reached the Square API rate limit. You might receive this error if your application sends a high number of requests
to Square APIs in a short period of time.

Your application should monitor responses for `429 RATE_LIMITED` errors and use a retry mechanism with an [exponential backoff](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exponential_backoff)
schedule to resend the requests at an increasingly slower rate. It is also a good practice to use a randomized delay (jitter) in your retry schedule.

x-enum-elements.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_ERROR
x-enum-elements.description:
An error occurred while processing a payment method. Most commonly,
the details of the payment method were invalid (such as a card's CVV
or expiration date).

x-enum-elements.name: REFUND_ERROR

x-enum-elements.name: MERCHANT_SUBSCRIPTION_ERROR

x-enum-elements.name: EXTERNAL_VENDOR_ERROR

request to the Connect API.

x-enum-elements.name: TRANSACTION_LIMIT
x-enum-elements.description:
The card issuer has determined the payment amount is either too high or too low.
The API returns the error code mostly for credit cards (for example, the card reached
the credit limit). However, sometimes the issuer bank can indicate the error for debit
or prepaid cards (for example, card has insufficient funds).

x-enum-elements.name: VOICE_FAILURE

For more information, see
